subject.title: feat: add model switch choices to /model

question: Should this PR receive merge approval only after a current-head Slack workspace run shows both `/model` menu rendering and successful selection dispatch?
rationale: The feature’s stated primary outcome is Slack native-command UX, but the available proof stops at registry output and explicitly excludes a live Slack interaction; accepting that gap is a maintainer judgment rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Require Slack proof
options.body: Request redacted current-head Slack screenshots, recording, terminal output, or logs that directly show the configured choices and the selected-model result.

options.title: Accept registry-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the shared registry smoke and existing Slack picker coverage while accepting that the exact live workspace path was not observed.

recommendation.title: Require Slack proof
